p35_resolution.previous_gap: The last round admitted that an instance seeded from a record would re-add an execution if it were told about it again (reload / second process).
p35_resolution.part_1_duplicate_path_proven_once: tests/model-cost/subagent-runtime.test.ts — new case: one execution's final 360000 is delivered before an existing commit, committed (saveVersion 2), then that same execution's completion AND a stale running reading of it are delivered again; the accumulation stays 360000 and the session's next commit (saveVersion 3) writes 360000, not 720000. Independent literals; the value comes from the fact→accumulation→save path, not from a pre-filled record.
p35_resolution.part_1_sensitivity: temporary mutation `if (false && accounted.has(runtime.executionId))` → the case fails (1080000 vs 360000); source restored, case passes.
p35_resolution.part_2_reload_reachability_real_host: tests/harness-dock/detail-tree.test.ts — new case 'a resumed process draws the runtime the document already carries': process 1 really delegates through the host's task tool, commits the child's runtime (754 ms in that run) and stops; process 2 over the SAME isolated home + run root resumes the session with the host's own switch_session and opens the detail form. The child row states exactly the document's figure (not twice it) and the resumed process writes nothing. Sensitivity: temporary `savedRuntime * 2` in ConsumptionView.runtime → the case fails (drawn 2000 vs saved 754); restored, passes.
p35_resolution.part_2_why_mechanism_evidence: temporary probe in the omp adapter (since removed) dumping the real host's delegation payloads during a delegating run: both frame kinds carry details {projectAgentsDir, results, totalDurationMs, progress}; the running frames state each spawn's own durationMs (42→770 and 31→444 for the two children of one task call) and each child's ended frame states its final one under results[] (780, 444). So the readings are the host's own and the final reading really arrives; a resumed transcript is not replayed as live tool-execution events, so no process is told about an execution its file already holds. Recorded in framework/docs/harness-support.md (execution.subagent-duration).
p35_resolution.part_2_design_note: No persisted per-execution identity was added: the approved contract leaves out a per-execution ledger and a time-specific write, and a persisted id list would misfile a harness that ever reused an identity. The accumulator's module doc now states the lifetime of its identity memory and why a restart is safe; the ticket records this as the resolution rather than a narrowed promise.
p35_resolution.reachable_duplicate_verified: The in-process duplicates (repeated notification, progress=replacement, stale frame, second observer in one process) are deduplicated by the accumulator and verified in tests/model-cost/subagent-runtime.test.ts (P12 cases) and tests/framework/subagent-runtime.test.ts (every frame mapped as it stands, each naming its execution); independent sessions in two real processes do not overwrite each other in tests/model-cost/storage-processes.test.ts (real child processes, real store commit).
